notes.subject: tsedek·mishpat·khesed·rakhamim
notes.rationale: Ol foa tok i wok long wanpela ridim — Yahwe i makim kontrak bilong em wantaim ol tupela tok mare.

notes.subject: marimari
notes.rationale: רחמים em i plural, klostu long bel bilong mama — marimari i holim tupela mining.

translation: Na bai mi tok mare long yu bilong mi, i go tru olgeta taim i no gat pinis; bai mi tok mare long yu bilong mi long tsedek, na long kot, na long khesed, na long marimari.
